decision_cruda.rationale: E569-08 stopped 5-8h, so LH-03 is idle. Central is truck-limited (inflow 159 vs 91 t/h), so a reserve there adds little. Norte has spare truck capacity (inflow 29 vs 66 t/h). RS-N548-03 grades 18.4 g/t with 311 t. LH-03 needs 0.72 h to travel plus 1.0 h to activate, so it starts about 11:43. That leaves about 5.2 h at 38.5 t/h, roughly 200 t, or about 118 oz. No development loader is taken, so no development cost. No loans are needed.
